homepage.hero.tagline.message: An out-of-the-box website + docs template for open-source projects

homepage.hero.desc.message: Config-driven navigation · Markdown content · React homepage

homepage.case.nav.desc.message: Categories, order and collapse state all live in sidebars.js — change the structure without touching components.

homepage.case.i18n.desc.message: Switch version (1.0.0 / Next) and language (简体中文 / English) right from the navbar.

homepage.feature.theme.desc.message: Built-in light and dark themes; follow the system or toggle manually, no extra config.

homepage.feature.version.desc.message: Multiple doc versions coexist; snapshot the current docs with a single command.

homepage.feature.i18n.desc.message: Built-in Chinese/English switching; translations live in per-locale directories.

homepage.feature.deploy.desc.message: GitHub Actions included: push to main and it publishes to GitHub Pages automatically.

homepage.feature.component.desc.message: The homepage is assembled from React components; customize Hero, feature cards and showcases freely.

homepage.feature.search.desc.message: Config-driven docs structure and sidebar, with on-page TOC and site navigation.

home.description.message: From unified LLM abstractions to Agent Runtime, AgentForge gives Java developers a transparent, controllable, and extensible foundation for intelligent agents.

home.flow.title.message: A clear path from intent to action

home.flow.desc.message: Every layer has a clear boundary. Every step can be observed, replaced and extended.

home.demo.prompt.message: Inspect the project and propose the next implementation plan.

home.demo.think.message: Identify the goal and current context

home.card.llm.message: OpenAI, Anthropic and other models share one interface, keeping upper layers free from vendor lock-in.

home.card.runtime.message: A ReAct loop coordinates reasoning, action, observation and stopping in a transparent runtime.

home.card.tool.message: Local Java methods, HTTP plugins and MCP services all become Function Calls with one unified pipeline for schema, argument binding, execution and result write-back.

home.card.memory.message: Combine conversations, runtime state and long-term memory into an extensible agent context.

home.capabilities.desc.message: Six core capabilities cover model access, tool calling, runtime governance and a ready-to-use workbench.

home.card.middleware.message: Attach logging, tracing, auditing and masking to model calls, tool execution and the Agent loop, keeping cross-cutting logic out of the main loop.

home.card.events.message: Unified messages and streaming events bring synchronous results, reasoning deltas, tool calls and frontend SSE onto the same semantics.

home.card.service.message: Model configuration, Agent debugging, version publishing, session replay and tracing out of the box — experience the full Agent workbench.

home.stack.desc.message: Compose upward from protocol contracts; every layer can be replaced independently.

home.modules.desc.message: Manage versions with one BOM and compose from model contracts to the Agent runtime.

home.code.title.message: Your first Agent in a few dozen lines

home.code.desc.message: Inject models, memory and tools, then run synchronously or with streaming. The same ReActAgent instance switches freely between both modes.

home.service.title.message: Skip the frontend work and start the workbench

home.service.desc.message: AgentForge Service provides model configuration, Agent debugging, version publishing, session replay and tracing. One Docker command gives you the full loop.

home.layer.tool.message: Local / HTTP / MCP unified ToolSpecification and executors

home.layer.react.message: Think → Act → memory write-back, sync, streaming, cancel and retry

home.layer.middleware.message: Composable cross-cutting logic across loop, model, tool and stop stages

home.layer.service.message: Permissions, approvals, sandboxes and a ready-to-use Agent workbench

home.module.api.message: Provider-neutral model contracts and unified req/vo

home.module.core.message: Default parameter merge, JDK HTTP transport and Tool engine

home.module.registry.message: Out-of-the-box ChatModel factory assembled from config

home.module.agent.message: ReAct Agent, Middleware, Memory and Tool extensions
